name: 12570 · Poughquag, NY
findings: ZIP 12570 (Poughquag) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 7 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12570 (Poughquag) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 12570 (Poughquag) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
